title: Office & Meetings
situation: Working with colleagues and joining meetings
description: Phrases for scheduling, discussing tasks and participating in workplace meetings.

phrases.pt: Podemos marcar uma reunião para amanhã?
phrases.en: Can we schedule a meeting for tomorrow?
phrases.ipa: poˈde.mus maʁˈkaʁ ˈu.mɐ ʁe.uˈni.ɐ̃w ˈpa.ɾɐ a.maˈɲɐ̃

phrases.pt: Qual é a pauta da reunião?
phrases.ipa: kwaw ɛ a ˈpaw.tɐ da ʁe.uˈni.ɐ̃w

phrases.en: I’m going to share my screen.

phrases.pt: Você pode me atualizar sobre o projeto?
phrases.en: Can you update me on the project?
phrases.ipa: voˈse ˈpɔ.dʒi mi a.tu.a.liˈzaʁ ˈso.bɾi u pɾoˈʒɛ.tu

phrases.pt: Qual é o prazo de entrega?
phrases.ipa: kwaw ɛ u ˈpɾa.zu dʒi ẽˈtɾe.ɡɐ

phrases.pt: Vou mandar um resumo por e-mail.
phrases.en: I’ll send a summary by email.
phrases.ipa: vow mɐ̃ˈdaʁ ũ ʁeˈzu.mu poʁ iˈmejw

phrases.en: We need to align the next steps.
Let’s come back to this subject later.
